== Research Notes ==
A possible identification concerns Mary Thomson. The 9 November 1860 Old Monkland marriage index records Mary Thomson, 37, and William Sneddon, 45, a widowed collier. Her parents are Robert Thomson and Mary Glasgon Thomson; his parents are Robert Sneddon and Mary Gray Sneddon.<ref>Scottish civil marriage index: Mary Thomson; [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:6TLK-6T1J record]; Extracted marriage index: Old Monkland; [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:XT1H-TBC record]; Indexed father Robert Sneddon; [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:6TLK-6T16 record]; Indexed mother Mary Gray Sneddon; [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:6TLK-6T1F record].</ref> FamilySearch index inspected after sign-in; original image requires a centre or affiliate library and remains uninspected. These indexes describe one event, not independent marriages. The identification remains uncertain.
